about_the_game:
Puzzle Princess is an casual adult puzzle building game. Strip each maiden as you complete each puzzle!

Key Features:

  • Complete 5 puzzles to see each maiden stripped bare!

  • After unlocking each puzzle, that puzzle can be played in custom mode, and the number of pieces can be chosen.

Gameplay Overview:

  • Fully Nude puzzles upon completion of a puzzle.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains naked anime ladies.
